brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells each contain a full-depth bin: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, forming a two-compartment utensil holder. One spoon prop placed to demonstrate use.

Configurator checks fit/collisions only; it has no data on material, print layer sealing, waterproofing or food safety. The bins are solid-wall trays (not drained) so the shape can contain water, but waterproof performance cannot be verified here and depends on user-chosen material/print settings.

Dishwasher/heat/food safety and material durability are outside the configurator's checks. Safety depends on filament chosen and printer settings, which this system does not validate; cannot be claimed as met.

finish.summary: Built a two-cell holder with two solid full-depth bins. Shape allows holding utensils and containing water, but waterproof and dishwasher-safe claims are unverifiable in this 3D-printed system and remain unmet.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
